# Plumbnorth

## About
Plumbnorth are the Cairns experts in Plumbing, specialising in Residential Plumbing, Commercial Plumbing and Industrial Plumbing. Plumbnorth prides itself on the delivery of professional workmanship, competitive pricing, reliability and safety. Based at 19 Knight Street, Portsmith QLD, servicing Cairns and surrounding areas.
